subject: add serial locale
patch:
--- mRemoteV1/Connection/Protocol/ProtocolType.cs
@@ -36,8 +36,11 @@ public enum ProtocolType
 
         [LocalizedAttributes.LocalizedDescription(nameof(Language.strPowerShell))]
         PowerShell = 10,
+        
+        [LocalizedAttributes.LocalizedDescription(nameof(Language.strSerial))]
+        Serial = 11,
 
         [LocalizedAttributes.LocalizedDescription(nameof(Language.strExtApp))]
         IntApp = 20
     }
-}
\ No newline at end of file
+}

triage.rationale: Serial localization and support already exist at Serial=9; importing legacy value 11 would collide with current ARD serialization.
